options.text:
This template will create a comprehensive demo environment with:
• 1 Community resource with governed services
• 8 Azure Enclave (Identity, Collaboration, Desktop, Platform, Weapon, SubKtr, Cyber, Offline)
• 1 Transit Hub for external connectivity
• Multiple Community Endpoints (External, Default Portal, Data Source, Windows Updates, Winget)
• 8 Workloads (one per enclave)
• 11 Enclave Endpoints for secure communication
• ~48 Enclave Connections demonstrating various connectivity patterns

elements.name: uniqueNumber
elements.label: Unique Number
elements.toolTip: A unique number to make the resources unique within the resource group. This enables easier multiple test deployments.

constraints.validationMessage: Unique number must be a numeric value between 1 and 4 digits.

options.text: Deploy a comprehensive demonstration environment using Azure Enclave. This template showcases multi-tenant scenarios with multiple organizations (Community Oversight, Prime Contractor, Weapon Contractor, Subcontractor, R&D Collaboration) working together in isolated yet connected enclaves. Perfect for demonstrations, training, and proof-of-concept scenarios.
Note: This template creates many resources and is intended for demonstration and testing purposes. It may take 30-45 minutes to complete deployment.

elements.name: enableTelemetry
elements.label: Enable Telemetry
elements.toolTip: Enable or disable usage telemetry for this template deployment

elements.name: communityName
elements.label: Community Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the community (e.g. cmt-azure-enclave-demo-template-test1). Also added to the front of community resource names.

constraints.validationMessage: Community name must be between 3 and 30 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

elements.name: enclaveNamePrefix
elements.label: Enclave Name Prefix
elements.toolTip: Prefix for the Enclave names (e.g. ve-azure-enclave-demo-template-test1)

constraints.validationMessage: Enclave name prefix must be between 3 and 25 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

elements.name: addressSpace
elements.label: Address Space
elements.toolTip: The address space for the community in CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)

constraints.validationMessage: Address space must be in valid CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

elements.name: networkSize
elements.label: Network Size
elements.toolTip: The size of the enclave virtual networks

options.text:
This demo environment will create the following enclaves:

• Identity - Shared identity services (ADDS)
• Collaboration - Collaborative workspaces
• Desktop - Virtual desktop infrastructure
• Platform - Prime contractor platform services
• Weapon - Weapon systems contractor enclave
• SubKtr - Subcontractor development enclave
• Cyber - Cybersecurity monitoring and tools
• Offline - Isolated environment for sensitive data

Each enclave represents a different organization or functional area, demonstrating multi-tenant isolation and selective connectivity.

elements.name: transitHubName
elements.label: Transit Hub Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the transit hub resource for external connectivity

constraints.validationMessage: Transit hub name must be between 3 and 30 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

elements.name: transitOptionType
elements.label: Transit Option Type
elements.toolTip: The type of transit connection (Gateway or ExpressRoute)

elements.name: scaleUnits
elements.label: Scale Units
elements.toolTip: Number of scale units for the transit hub (1-10)

elements.name: remoteVirtualNetworkId
elements.label: Remote Virtual Network ID
elements.toolTip: The resource ID of the remote virtual network (required if using Peering transit option)

constraints.validationMessage: Must be empty or a valid virtual network resource ID.

options.text:
The demo environment includes:

• External connectivity via Transit Hub
• Azure Portal access for all enclaves
• Windows Updates and Winget package management
• Identity services (ADDS) accessible from most enclaves
• Cyber enclave with monitoring access to all other enclaves
• Inter-enclave connectivity between Platform, Weapon, and SubKtr enclaves
• Data source connectivity for the Desktop enclave

This demonstrates various connectivity patterns for secure multi-tenant environments.
